question_en:
I want to find the first set in the image whose printed building instructions exceed 80 pages, suitable for a longer building project. Please start from the main card in the bottom-right corner of the product area, query the corresponding official LEGO Building Instructions page for each of the six product main cards along their outer edge in a counter-clockwise direction, and check the paper instruction manual PDF linked on the page; stop when the PDF first exceeds 80 pages. Please answer the following questions:

1. In the actual order of access, which sets were verified? What are their set numbers, the piece count shown in the image, and the page count of the paper instruction manual PDF? What is the name and number of the first set that meets the condition?
2. How many different Building Instructions pages and how many different paper instruction manual PDFs were verified in total?

Answer Format: Please answer in points numbered (1)—(2); for Question 1, use a table to list the set name, number, piece count, and PDF page count in order, and mark the first set that meets the condition in a "Continue/Stop" column; for Question 2, state the numbers of different Building Instructions pages and instruction PDFs checked separately in text.
answer:
(1)

| Access Order | Set Name | Set Number | Piece Count in Image | Paper Instruction Manual PDF Page Count | Judgment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Spider-Man vs. Sandman: Final Battle | 76280 | 347 | 72 | Continue |
| 2 | Venom Mech Armor vs. Miles Morales | 76276 | 134 | 76 | Continue |
| 3 | Spider-Man Race Car & Venom Green Goblin | 76279 | 227 | 80 | Continue |
| 4 | Potted Groot | 40671 | 113 | 36 | Continue |
| 5 | War Machine Mech Armor | 76277 | 154 | 76 | Continue |
| 6 | Rocket & Baby Groot | 76282 | 566 | 100 | Stop |

(2) A total of 6 different Building Instructions pages and 6 different paper instruction manual PDFs were verified.
